messages:
Maya: Heads up — Solentra flagged invoice 78942 after their private deploy migration. They say the platform fee appears twice.
Elliot: Looking now, can you paste the offending lines?
Maya: Sure: ```PLATFORM_FEE | 2025-02 | $12,500
PLATFORM_FEE | Migration Credit | $12,500``` Customer expected the migration credit to be applied as a negative line on renewal, not an immediate separate charge.
Carlos: From Solentra: they received two charges on the same invoice and want a refund.
Priya: Contract wise do we allow refunds for migration credits? My recollection: migration credits apply to first renewal only (non-refundable). Need to confirm SOW.
Maya: Pulling SOW now — clause 3.2: "Migration credit applies to first annual renewal; credit is not convertible to cash."
Elliot: Ok. Finance system shows invoice 78942 with both a positive PLATFORM_FEE line and a positive PLATFORM_FEE labeled Migration Credit — looks like our AR ingestion sign got the credit as a charge.
Jenna: @Elliot can you open a billing ticket and tag ops? If money already moved we may need AR reversal + memo.
Elliot: Created BILLING-3421: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILLING-3421 — tagging @Maya @Priya for context.
billing-bot: Invoice 78942 status changed to "Paid" (stripe_tx_9a8be)
Maya: If paid, options: 1) issue refund of $12,500, 2) issue negative invoice to offset and keep funds, 3) eat it (not ideal). Customer prefers refund.
Priya: @Carlos confirm whether Solentra will accept offset on next renewal.
Carlos: They want refund. They've flagged an "error > $10k" in their legal team and are pushing for immediate refund.
Maya: Given refund request + customer escalation, we need approvals from CFO and Head of Sales for a one-time exception.
Priya: Looping in @Dana (CFO) and @Liam (Head of Sales) — please advise.
Dana: Dana: I approve issuing a refund in this case. Contract language is ambiguous to a lay reader and customer relationship risk is high. Finance proceed with refund and adjust GL.
Liam: Liam: Support refund. Also remove duplicate charge from renewal forecast so AE knows renewal number changed.
Elliot: Will process refund today and post refund memo to BILLING-3421. Then create correction negative invoice for audit trail and update renewal draft to remove duplicate platform fee.
Maya: ETA? Customer success wants to notify Solentra with timeline.
Elliot: Refund initiated to original payment method, refund id rfd_3b7a. Should clear in 3-5 business days; I'll paste proof when settled. Negative invoice created: CN-78942-1 (-$12,500).
Jenna: Noted. I'll update the CS playbook and attach the case notes.
Priya: I'll draft the outbound email: apology, proof of refund id, reconciliation plan, and confirm renewal amount change.
Carlos: Thanks team — please DM me when refund posts so I can close the customer ticket.
Maya: Closing loop: BILLING-3421 will track refund + GL adjustments + renewal invoice update. Thanks everyone.
